description: Machine-readable state machines of ASGEND Remote API v1 (normative prose: docs/API_CONTRACT.md §3). 'new' = object does not exist yet. 'by': user = user/client API call, node = Execution Node call (ack, events, snapshot), server = Control Plane timer/decision. A transition whose from == to is a no-op and never emits state_changed. Anything not listed is rejected: user API -> 409 conflict, node events -> rejected[] with code conflict.

transitions.trigger: POST /v1/workspaces/{ws}/tasks creates the task and its submit command
ack outcome=accepted of the submit command (sets core_task_id)
ack outcome=rejected of the submit command
submit command expired (TTL) or node revoked
node event state_changed or snapshot; intermediate states may be skipped
core retry_task after an acked retry command (event or snapshot)
POST /v1/tasks/{task}/retry creates a new submit command with the original payload
submit/answer/cancel/retry API call (outbox insert in the same transaction)
ack outcome=accepted with the current lease_id
ack outcome=rejected with the current lease_id
expires_at passed, node revoked, or the task became delivery_failed
